features: Fast Extraction, Smooth & Work-Ready: The optimized 3.5-bar pressure system extracts gently to reduce bitterness, delivering a noticeably smooth, mild brew for those who prefer a delicate coffee profile. Combined with rapid 800W preheating, this espresso machine is ready to brew almost instantly—making your morning routine refreshly efficient before you head to work

Powerful Steam Wand, Silky Milk Foam: This espresso maker features an 800W integrated steam wand delivers steady, powerful steam to create velvety microfoam in seconds—ideal for smooth lattes, cappuccinos, and latte art practice at home with zero extra cost. The silicone grip stays cool and flexible, allowing you to adjust the frothing angle comfortably and safely, keeping hands away from heat and burns

Effortless One-Knob Operation: These espresso coffee machines are designed with simplicity in mind, they feature just three core functions: brew, steam, and off. The intuitive mechanical knob eliminates complex menus and fragile electronics, resulting in a low failure rate and easy maintenance. No barista skills needed—beginners, seniors, and busy users can brew with confidence. A practical and elegant gift for everyday coffee lovers

BPA-Free Measuring Cup, Quick Cleanup: Equipped on these espresso machines for home, the custom-fit, splash-proof cup prevents messy drips and spills, keeping your countertop clean. Made of BPA-free, food-grade Tritan, it’s odorless and heat-safe. The precise scale marks ensure consistent flavor extraction, while the secure lock design prevents accidental drops, leaks, or scalding for everyday safety

Ultra-Compact, Grab-and-Go Design: This small espresso machine measures just 8.3”D x 6”W x 11.8”H and weighs only 3.3 lbs; this steam espresso maker is built for small kitchens, dorms, offices, apartments, and RV trips. The lightweight, one-hand portable body makes it easy to move, store, or take on the go—perfect for minimalists and single living

1-Year Warranty & Easy Use Support: Includes 1-year warranty. Comes with a clear, easy-to-read manual, so even beginners can easily complete setup and operation. Plus step-by-step video tutorials are available at the XIXUBX store for better brewing results
